posts.message: ⚠️ Confirmed: Analysis of network data indicates a significant decline in internet traffic in #Cuba corresponding to reports of a nation-wide power blackout. The incident comes as the island faces ongoing fuel shortages #apagón

⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show internet cuts corresponding to power outages in Sevastopol, occupied Crimea, intensifying amid Ukranian UAV attacks targeting energy infrastructure, with connectivity at 29% of ordinary levels as the regional Russian leadership imposes rolling blackouts

ℹ️ Note: Meta platforms including Instagram and Facebook are currently experiencing international outages; incident not related to country-level internet disruptions or filtering #InstagramDown #FacebookDown

⚠️Confirmed: Metrics show a disruption to internet service in #Kenya with national connectivity at 69% of ordinary levels; the incident corresponds to a widespread power outage affecting parts of the country including Nairobi 📉
⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a significant disruption to internet connectivity in Sumy, #Ukraine corresponding to power outages after overnight Russian attacks targeting energy infrastructure 📉
⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a disruption to multiple social media platforms in Guinea corroborating user reports of difficulty accessing Facebook, YouTube and TikTok #Guinée

⚠️ Confirmed: Network data show that major internet provider TurkNet in #Turkey is currently experiencing a nation-scale outage, corroborating widespread user complaints; the company says engineers are working to restore service 📉

⚠️ Confirmed: Live metrics show a gradual decline in internet connectivity in Spokane County, Washington corresponding to evacuations and emergency power shutdowns in areas affected by the Old Trails Fire, a rapidly moving wildfire 🚒

⚠️ Confirmed: Analysis of network data indicates a significant decline in internet traffic in #Cuba corresponding to reports of a national power blackout. The incident comes amid continuing fuel shortages #apagón

⚠️ Confirmed: #Georgia has experienced the third in a series of nation-scale internet disruptions corresponding to power grid blackouts.

Authorities say today's incident was triggered by tests intended to diagnose Enguri HPP systems responsible for the earlier two outages.

⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a major disruption to internet connectivity in Odesa, #Ukraine, corresponding to power outages after Russian missile and drone attacks target energy infrastructure in one of the year’s largest bombardments on the seaport city to date 📉
⚠️ Confirmed: Network data show disruptions to internet connectivity in parts of western #Colombia corresponding to infrastructure outages after a ~7.4 magnitude earthquake

⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a significant decline in internet connectivity in northwest Indiana as heavy storms brings down power and telecoms lines, knocking hundreds of thousands of subscribers in the Midwest offline 🔌 #INwx

⚠️ Confirmed: Internet connectivity has been largely knocked out in Sevastopol, occupied Crimea, amid power outages caused by Ukrainian drone attacks targeting energy infrastructure. The incident is the latest in a series of intensifying blackouts 🔌

⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show that popular web host and domain registrar #Namecheap is largely down, sending many websites and services offline. The company says it has been struck by both a DDoS attack and a power outage.

ℹ️ Update: Connectivity is gradually returning to web host and domain registrar #Namecheap after a multi-hour platform-wide outage. Status updates point to ongoing overheating issues amid a power outage at the phoenixNAP data center that has impacted multiple hosting providers.

⚠️ Confirmed: Live metrics show a significant decline in internet connectivity in parts of #Hawaii including Hilo as Hurricane Lala batters the Big Island, corresponding to widespread power outages due to torrential rains and a heavy storm surge.

⚠️ Update: Live metrics show internet disruptions have expanded across #Hawaii to impact the capital Honolulu as Hurricane Lala skirts the archipelago, corresponding to widespread power outages that have left hundreds of thousands without electricity 🔌 #HIwx

⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a sudden decline in internet connectivity across Russian-controlled Crimea with high impact to Sevastopol and Simferopol corresponding to a power blackout after overnight Ukrainian drone attacks targeting energy infrastructure 🔌

⚠️ Confirmed: A power outage has knocked out internet connectivity across much of Donbas, Russian-occupied #Ukraine; the losses in service are attributed to Ukrainian UAV attacks targeting a thermal power plant in Luhansk Oblast 🔌
